1.text: Ku wa mbere w'iminsi irindwi, kare mu museke bajya ku gituro bajyanye bya bihumura neza batunganije.

2.text: Babona igitare kibirinduye kivuye ku gituro,

4.text: Bakiguye mu kantu, abagabo babiri bahagarara aho bari bambaye imyenda irabagirana.

5.text: Abagore baratinya bubika amaso, nuko abo bagabo barababaza bati “Ni iki gitumye mushakira umuzima mu bapfuye?

6.text: Ntari hano ahubwo yazutse. Mwibuke ibyo yavuganye namwe akiri i Galilaya ati

7.text: ‘Umwana w'umuntu akwiriye kugambanirwa ngo afatwe n'amaboko y'abanyabyaha, abambwe maze azazuke ku munsi wa gatatu.’ ”

9.text: Bava ku gituro basubirayo, ibyo byose babibwira abigishwa cumi n'umwe n'abandi bose.

10.text: Abo ni Mariya Magadalena na Yowana, na Mariya nyina wa Yakobo, n'abandi bagore bari hamwe na bo babwira intumwa ibyo babonye.

11.text: Ariko ayo magambo ababera nk'impuha ntibayemera.

12.text: Maze Petero arahaguruka yirukanka ajya ku gituro, arunama arungurukamo, abona imyenda y'ibitare iri yonyine. Asubira iwe atangazwa n'ibyabaye.

13.text: Nuko uwo munsi babiri muri bo bajyaga mu kirorero cyitwa Emawusi. (Kuva i Yerusalemu kugerayo ni nka sitadiyo mirongo itandatu.)

15.text: Bakiganira babazanya, Yesu arabegera ajyana na bo,

16.text: Ariko amaso yabo arabuzwa ngo batamumenya.

17.text: Arababaza ati “Muragenda mubazanya ibiki?”Bahagarara bagaragaje umubabaro.

18.text: Umwe muri bo witwaga Kilewopa aramusubiza ati “Mbese ni wowe wenyine mu bashyitsi b'i Yerusalemu, utazi ibyahabaye muri iyi minsi?”

19.text: Arababaza ati “Ni ibiki?”Bati “Ni ibya Yesu w'i Nazareti, wari umuhanuzi ukomeye mu byo yakoraga n'ibyo yavugaga imbere y'Imana n'imbere y'abantu bose,

20.text: kandi twavuganaga uburyo abatambyi bakuru n'abatware bacu, bamutanze ngo acirwe urubanza rwo gupfa bakamubamba,

21.text: kandi twiringiraga yuko ari we uzacungura Abisirayeli. Uretse ibyo, dore uyu munsi ni uwa gatatu uhereye aho ibyo byabereye.

22.text: None abagore bo muri twe badutangaje, kuko bazindutse bajya ku gituro

23.text: ntibasangamo intumbi ye. Nuko baraza batubwira ko babonekewe n'abamarayika, bakababwira ko ari muzima.

24.text: Kandi bamwe mu bari bari kumwe na twe bagiye ku gituro basanga ari ko biri, uko abagore batubwiye, ariko we ntibamubona.”

25.text: Arababwira ati “Mwa bapfu mwe, imitima yanyu itinze cyane kwizera ibyo abahanuzi bavuze byose.

26.text: None se Kristo ntiyari akwiriye kubabazwa atyo, ngo abone kwinjira mu bwiza bwe?”

27.text: Atangirira kuri Mose no ku bahanuzi bose, abasobanurira mu byanditswe byose ibyanditswe kuri we.

28.text: Bageze bugufi bw'ikirorero bajyagamo, agira nk'ushaka kugicaho.

29.text: Baramuhata bati “Se waretse tukagumana kuko bwije kandi umunsi ukaba ukuze?” Nuko arinjira ngo agumane na bo.

30.text: Yicaye ngo asangire na bo, yenda umutsima arawushimira, arawumanyagura arawubaha.

31.text: Amaso yabo arahumuka baramumenya, maze aburira imbere yabo ntibongera kumubona.

32.text: Baravugana bati “Yewe, ntiwibuka ukuntu imitima yacu yari ikeye, ubwo yavuganaga natwe turi mu nzira adusobanurira ibyanditswe!”

33.text: Uwo mwanya barahaguruka basubira i Yerusalemu, basanga abo cumi n'umwe bateranye hamwe n'abandi,

34.text: bumva bavuga bati “Ni ukuri Umwami Yesu yazutse, ndetse yabonekeye Simoni.”

35.text: Nuko ba bandi babiri na bo babatekerereza ibyabereye mu nzira, n'uburyo bamumenyeshejwe n'uko amanyaguye umutsima.

36.text: Bakivuga ibyo, Yesu ahagarara hagati yabo arababwira ati “Amahoro abe muri mwe.”

37.text: Maze barikanga, bagira ubwoba bwinshi bagira ngo ni umuzimu babonye.

38.text: Arababwira ati “Ikibahagaritse imitima ni iki, kandi ni iki gitumye mwiburanya mu mitima yanyu?

39.text: Nimurebe ibiganza byanjye n'ibirenge byanjye, mumenye ko ari jye ubwanjye. Ndetse nimunkoreho murebe, kuko umuzimu atagira umubiri n'amagufwa nk'ibyo mundebana.”

40.text: Avuze ibyo abereka ibiganza bye n'ibirenge bye.

41.text: Nuko ibinezaneza bikibabujije kubyemera, bagitangara arababaza ati “Hari icyo kurya mufite hano?”

44.text: Maze arababwira ati “Aya ni amagambo nababwiraga nkiri kumwe namwe, yuko ibyanditswe kuri jye byose mu mategeko ya Mose, no mu byahanuwe no muri Zaburi bikwiriye gusohora.”

45.text: Maze abungura ubwenge ngo basobanukirwe n'ibyanditswe,

46.text: ati “Ni ko byanditswe ko Kristo akwiriye kubabazwa no kuzuka ku munsi wa gatatu,

47.text: kandi ko kwihana no kubabarirwa ibyaha bikwiriye kubwirwa amahanga yose mu izina rye, bahereye kuri Yerusalemu.

49.text: Kandi dore ngiye kuboherereza ibyo Data yasezeranye, ariko mugume mu murwa kugeza ubwo muzambikwa imbaraga zivuye mu ijuru.”

50.text: Abajyana hanze, abageza i Betaniya arambura amaboko hejuru, abaha umugisha.

51.text: Akibaha umugisha atandukanywa na bo, ajyanwa mu ijuru.

52.text: Na bo baramuramya, basubirana i Yerusalemu umunezero mwinshi,

53.text: baguma mu rusengero iteka bashima Imana.
